title: Gateway staging: a keyless table's update is a DELETE and an INSERT with the same sequence

found.by: lfc-schema-change-test gateway-staging samples: SQL Server 2022 CU27, standard CDC, utility 1.7, serverless gateway

symptom: UPDATE TOP (1) ... on a table with no primary key stages DELETE (1,a) and INSERT (1,a2) with identical cursor.sequence
cause: the keyless row has no key to update, so the change is written as a delete of the old row and an insert of the new, both at the change's one position
effect: a reader that orders by sequence alone can apply the INSERT before the DELETE and lose the row
fix: order by sequence, then by the record's position in its change file (line number); for the destination side see sqlserver-keyless-duplicates-collapse
